audience: accounts receivable teams who chase customer payments with Invoiced

useCases.title: Find past-due invoices and what each customer owes
useCases.text: The AI lists invoices with status, dates, totals and balance, filtered by customer, paid flag or date range. It sums up the open amounts per customer.

useCases.title: Check one customer's balance and contacts
useCases.text: The AI reads a customer's outstanding, past due and available credit, plus the customer's terms and contacts.

useCases.title: Review the payments you received
useCases.text: The AI lists payments with customer, date, amount and method, and reads one payment with the invoices and credit notes it was applied to.

useCases.title: Review subscriptions and plans
useCases.text: The AI lists subscriptions with customer, plan, status, recurring total and MRR, and reads one subscription or plan.

useCases.title: Create a customer or a draft invoice
useCases.text: The AI creates a customer, or a draft invoice with line items from your catalog. A draft is not issued, emailed or charged until a person finalizes it.

useCases.title: Add a collection note or task
useCases.text: The AI adds an internal note to a customer or invoice, or creates a task to call, write, email or review. It also reads existing notes and tasks.
